 await t.test('EXTERNAL MONTH lifecycle and private metadata/column ACL gate',async()=>{for(const suffix of ['precheck','backup',''])await q(await read('../supabase/folha_externos_conferencia'+(suffix?'_'+suffix:'')+'.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_externos_conferencia_postcheck.sql'));await q('GRANT SELECT(estrutura) ON primeline_externo_mes_backup.estrutura TO authenticated');try{await assert.rejects(q(await read('../supabase/folha_externos_conferencia_postcheck.sql')),/ADDON_BACKUP_NOT_PRIVATE/);}finally{await q('ROLLBACK');await q('REVOKE SELECT(estrutura) ON primeline_externo_mes_backup.estrutura FROM authenticated');}await q(await read('../supabase/folha_externos_conferencia_rollback.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_externos_conferencia.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_externos_conferencia_postcheck.sql'));});
 const externalMonth=today.slice(0,7)+'-01',externalConfirmBody=rev=>({version:3,request_id:id(seq++),work_id:id(100),provider_id:id(300),month:externalMonth,expected_revision:rev});
 const xc=(actor,body,c=false,token=null,conn=a)=>as(conn,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_externos_confirmar_v3($1::jsonb,$2::boolean,$3::text) v',[body,c,token]);
 const xe=(actor,work=100,provider=300)=>as(a,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_externos_excel_contexto_v3($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3::date) v',[id(work),id(provider),externalMonth]);
 let firstExternalConfirmation;
 await t.test('EXTERNAL MONTH Diretor confirms actual revision before Excel; admin/foreman cannot approve',async()=>{await assert.rejects(xe(14),/EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED/);for(const actor of [10,11,12,13,15,17])await assert.rejects(xc(actor,externalConfirmBody(0)),e=>e.code==='42501');const body=externalConfirmBody(0),preview=await xc(14,body);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_externos_confirmacoes')).rows[0].n,0);firstExternalConfirmation=await xc(14,body,true,preview.versao);assert.equal(firstExternalConfirmation.committed,true);assert.deepEqual(await xc(14,body,true,preview.versao),firstExternalConfirmation);const exported=await xe(14);assert.equal(exported.export_format,'xlsx');assert.equal(exported.confirmation_id,firstExternalConfirmation.confirmation_id);assert.equal(exported.confirmed_by,id(14));assert.ok(exported.report.records.every(x=>x.kind==='external'));assert.equal(exported.financial_effect,false);});
 await t.test('EXTERNAL MONTH provider/tenant/work scope and direct fake GUC denied',async()=>{await assert.rejects(xe(14,103),e=>e.code==='42501');await assert.rejects(xe(14,100,301),e=>e.code==='42501');await a.query('BEGIN');try{await a.query('SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated');await a.query("SELECT set_config('folha.external_rpc','on',true)");await assert.rejects(a.query('DELETE FROM folha_externos_confirmacoes'),e=>e.code==='42501');}finally{await a.query('ROLLBACK');}});
 await t.test('EXTERNAL MONTH correction by authorized Diretor requires motive/revision/history, invalidates Excel',async()=>{const row=(await q('SELECT revision FROM folha_registos WHERE externo_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2 AND data=$3',[readerExternalId,id(100),today])).rows[0];const body={version:3,request_id:id(seq++),kind:'external',person_id:readerExternalId,work_id:id(100),date:today,expected_revision:row.revision,intervals:[{start:'08:00',end:'12:00',period:'manha',mode:'normal'},{start:'13:00',end:'17:15',period:'tarde',mode:'normal'}]};await assert.rejects(dstCall(14,body),/CORRECTION_REASON_REQUIRED/);const done=await dstSave(14,{...body,reason:'Correção documentada pelo Diretor'});assert.equal(done.record.minutes,495);assert.equal(done.record.atualizado_por,id(14));assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_historico WHERE request_id=$1 AND ator_id=$2',[body.request_id,id(14)])).rows[0].n,1);await assert.rejects(xe(14),/EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED/);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_externos_confirmacoes')).rows[0].n,1);});
 await t.test('EXTERNAL MONTH reconfirmation two connections one immutable revision, old approval intact',async()=>{const body=externalConfirmBody(1);await assert.rejects(xc(14,body),/CORRECTION_REASON_REQUIRED/);body.reason='Relatório revisto após correção';const p=await xc(14,body),out=await Promise.all([xc(14,body,true,p.versao,a),xc(14,body,true,p.versao,b)]);assert.deepEqual(out[0],out[1]);assert.equal(out[0].revision,2);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_externos_confirmacoes')).rows[0].n,2);assert.equal((await xe(14)).revision,2);assert.equal((await q('SELECT id FROM folha_externos_confirmacoes WHERE revision=1')).rows[0].id,firstExternalConfirmation.confirmation_id);await assert.rejects(xc(14,{...body,reason:'outro'},true,p.versao),/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/);});
 await t.test('EXTERNAL MONTH rollback after confirmation refuses immutable history loss',async()=>{await assert.rejects(q(await read('../supabase/folha_externos_conferencia_rollback.sql')),/ADDON_USED_ROLLBACK_OR_POSTCHECK/);await q('ROLLBACK');assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_externos_confirmacoes')).rows[0].n,2);});
